h13.

**`*markdown.service` (the sole implementation) — built once by `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service` via `markdown.NewService(...)` — held by `APIV1Service`, `rss.RSSService`, and (unused) `memopayload.Runner`.**

**The interface**
- `markdown.Service` is declared in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55` (ExtractAll, ExtractTags, ExtractProperties, RenderMarkdown, RenderHTML, GenerateSnippet, ValidateContent, RenameTag).

**Concrete implementation — exactly one**
- `type service struct { md goldmark.Markdown }` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`, methods on `*service` at lines 143, 193, 244, 255, 264, 349, 356, 425. There are no mocks, fakes, or alternate implementations anywhere in the repo — every holder gets a real `*service`.
- It is a goldmark pipeline (`github.com/yuin/goldmark v1.8.2`, go.mod:33) configured with GFM plus optional custom extenders `extensions.TagExtension` / `extensions.MentionExtension` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:91-108`, `internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`, `internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`). `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag` delegate to a second renderer, `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`), for AST→markdown output.

**Construction at runtime**
- The only production call site is `apiv1.NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, which builds it with **both** extensions enabled (`WithTagExtension()`, `WithMentionExtension()`) and stores it on the struct (`v1.go:56`).
- Nothing else constructs one in production; `server/server.go:85` reuses that same instance — `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` — so a single `*service` value is shared process-wide.
- Other `markdown.NewService` calls are test-only: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` (both extensions), `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54` (no extensions), `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427` (tags only).

**Holders of the interface type (3 struct fields)**
- `apiv1.APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`. Used at `memo_mention_helpers.go:32` (`ExtractAll`), `memo_service_webhooks.go:85` (`GenerateSnippet`), and passed into `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, set in `NewRSSService` (`rss.go:58-63`), used at `rss.go:339` for `RenderHTML` in feed generation.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, used at `runner.go:52`. Caveat: `memopayload.NewRunner` (`runner.go:19`) has **no call sites** — `server/server.go` only wires `s3presign.NewRunner` (`server.go:162`). So this holder is dead at runtime; the payload-rebuild path that actually executes is the free function `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)` (`runner.go:74`), which takes the interface as a parameter rather than holding it.

Note the interface is backend-only: per the doc comment at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:29-30`, user-facing HTML rendering happens in the frontend with markdown-it, and the Go `RenderHTML` exists for RSS and other server-side rendering.
